quote: If they're metering the usage of the models and providing the best dev tools, I think there is a business model there.

quote: The reports of their death were premature and exaggerated... if you fold that back into a Google, if you think about what they're doing now on the search side, these guys may be really kicking some ass here.

summary: Friedberg argues Google's AI Overviews will keep users on-page longer, increasing both search volume and revenue-per-query, while hidden assets like Isomorphic Labs — which peers like Meta and Amazon lack — represent additional upside options the market is undervaluing.
quote: Meta and Amazon do not have an isomorphics lab and Waymo sitting inside their business that suddenly pops to a couple hundred billion of market cap. And Google does have a few of those.

summary: Sacks argues Google's monopoly is so durable it can absorb major AI missteps and ultimately copy innovators like Perplexity to dominate AI search, potentially growing into a $5 trillion company.
quote: They can make 10 mistakes, but their monopoly is so strong that they can finally get it right by copying the innovator. And they're probably gonna become a $5 trillion company now.

quote: We've invested a ton of money. This was stealth for 5 years. We put a ton of money into this business. So when you invest that, um, I mean north of 50.
